provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled dilute neutral-solute partitioning with constant concentration ratio K=C_organic/C_water at equilibrium. Each stage uses a fresh organic phase of total_available_volume/n, equilibrates with the unchanged aqueous volume, then completely removes that organic aliquot before the next stage. No evaporation, entrained phase, chemical reaction, pH change or saturation.
target: Compare final aqueous AMOUNT remaining after the entire fresh-stage protocol, relative to starting amount. Only listed finite stage counts are candidates; no extra solvent may be spent in any design. A one-stage concentration ratio is not itself a recovered amount fraction.
scope: Theoretical stagewise mass-balance analysis, not an operational separation protocol or a forecast of real extraction efficiency.
